text_block_list.text:
While working late in the Trainer's 
office, someone enters with a knock.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Good evening, Mobile Acupuncturist Service 
at your service~ I've come to poke your 
pupil's vital pressure points~

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, they're not even here. Well, given 
the hour, I suppose it can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Well then, just pick out your menu 
first☆ I'll make sure the treatment is all 
done by tomorrow!"

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? Are you feeling anxious? 
Well, don't you worry, be at eeeease☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm just gonna give dear little <chrname> a quick 
poke with the bamboo needle!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
If you succeed, any ideal you hold will be 
yours☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Dunno~. 'Cause I've never failed before!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...Well, this is actually my first time 
getting a proper treatment, though.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it everything I've got, okay?! 
So don't you worry about a thiiing☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what do you want for your pupil? 
Just leave it to me, I'll make it happen 
in one poke~

"...It carries a terrifyingly dangerous 
scent, but there is a non-zero chance that 
it might produce some kind of incredible 
effect... maybe."
What should I do...?
choice_data_list: I want them to become a strong Umamusume
I want them to be able to win races
I want them to be fit and healthy
I want you to boost your charm.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm! "I want to become a strong 
Umamusume!" Got it!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm going to stab it right in, okay? 
You ready? ...Are you reeeeaaaallly, truly 
ready?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Okey-dokey, leave it to me~! ...Look 
forward to tomorrow☆
The next day, showing up for training, <chrname>—
A direct hit! Great success!

She was brimming with an unrecognizable 
amount of power!

It looks like she's seized her chance. I 
felt that we had taken a huge step toward 
our dream...!
She was visibly out of shape...

Deep regret washed over them—they never 
should have fallen for such a suspicious 
invitation...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! P-Please don't say that~...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Aww, stingy, stingy, stingy~~! Just let me 
stab you a little bit~!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, are you working overtime? Oh 
my... is someone here with you?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Whoa, bad timing☆ Well, what can you do~?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Time to scatt~er! ☆

Looks like the storm has passed... I 
should just focus on the work in front of 
me and forget about today.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, did you make a mistake? Well, it 
happens to the best of us, it really does!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Alright, tell me one more time. What do ya 
want your cute Umamusume to become!?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:

Hurry! Hurry!
